title: Horion v1.2.0 - Google Sites (Feb 6, 2026)
description: The database jumps from 1938 to 2200 entries and seven more games get featured - from Brawl Stars and Plants Vs Zombies to a Papa's cooking game. The build stamp says the update went live Feb 4; this save is from the 6th. Saved copy of the Google Sites page.
